plugins.name: phished
plugins.description: Phished MCP plus reporting, simulation and risk-detection scripts for Claude Code

skills.name: department-report
skills.description: Use to build a security-awareness report for one department in Phished. Triggers on "department report", "how is <department> doing", "risk report for the Sales department".

skills.name: detect-new-in-risk-categories
skills.description: Use to detect which recipients newly entered a risk category in Phished, where risk categories are recipient tags (e.g. "first-time clicker", "low BRS"). Triggers on "who's new in the high-risk group", "detect new risky users", "risk category changes since last week". Designed to run unattended on a schedule.
headings: Detect who is new in the risk categories

skills.name: generate-simulation
skills.description: Use when the user wants to generate company-specific phishing simulation templates for Phished, grounded in a company's website and documentation. Triggers on "generate a simulation", "company-specific simulation", "make a phishing template for <company>".

skills.name: my-department
skills.description: Use to give a focused report for a single department the user names — a lightweight, department-scoped view. Triggers on "show me my department", "how is <department> doing", "report for the Marketing department".

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description: Use to onboard a new Phished organisation end to end — create and verify a domain, add recipients (or set up user provisioning), set up simulations, and set up the Academy. Triggers on "onboard a new customer", "set up Phished from scratch", "get us started on Phished".
headings: Phase 1b — Confirm email delivery is set up (whitelisting / DMI)
Phase 2 — Recipients (upload, or set up provisioning)

skills.name: periodic-report
skills.description: Use for weekly / monthly / quarterly Phished reporting that the user can chat with, Power BI style. Triggers on "monthly report", "how did we do this quarter", "weekly security posture", followed by drill-down questions.

skills.name: team-report
skills.description: Use to build a security-awareness report for one team in Phished. Triggers on "team report", "how is <team> doing". Note the platform has no "team" entity — this maps to a location (or department).
